title: Coupon discountPercent changed to discountMinor
query: What breaks across repositories if the coupon discount changes from discountPercent to a minor-unit discountMinor amount?

proposed_change.diff:
-public record Coupon(String code, int discountPercent, boolean active) {}
+public record Coupon(String code, long discountMinor, boolean active) {}

affected_repositories.name: basket-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns Coupon, CouponRow, and BasketPricing.discount percent math

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: BasketClient snapshots couponCode; PriceBreakdown discountMinor semantics shift

affected_repositories.name: commerce-web
affected_repositories.evidence_note: BasketPage coupon form and PriceBreakdown discount rendering

notes: Business-rule change disguised as a field change. Percent-to-amount is not a rename: every total computed from it shifts meaning, and the pricing math must be rewritten, not remapped.
